en: Hound on the horizon moving at thirty feet per second. The only question is, right or left eye. That's right $g lad : lass;, I'm that good.
We don't have time to talk!  We have to think about those trolls!

<High Inquisitor Fairbanks lifts up his tabard revealing several gruesome scars.>$B$BBecause I was there... I was the Highlord's most trusted advisor. I should have known... I felt that something was amiss yet I allowed it to happen. Would you believe that there were a thousand or more Scourge?
%s's anger explodes as he goes into a frenzied rage!
You will not escape death!
The druids say that it is only a matter of time until nature itself drives the Horde from Kalimdor. Yet corruption continues to spread throughout our lands, even here on Teldrassil.
Okay, well... don't get cocky! Since you have demonstrated  your competence though, we may now begin!

All of the collecting is done and the finished goods are being shipped over to Silithus as they're being completed. Looks like less than a day until all of it is over there. After that we just need to get someone to ring that gong and open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj. Then the real fun begins.
Elder Hammershout can be found within the walls of Stormwind.
I cannot store any more supplies.  I have all I can handle!
I hear there's a shop up in Ironforge run by the gnomes that specializes in alchemy.  You should go have a look.
We have auction house in central ring.
Thank you kindly!
I love the smell of Ironforge in the morning!  Eh? And what would you be needing $c?
Ok, let's take a look at this thing...

Ah, I believe Gimble Thistlefuzz is who ye'll be needing if yer looking to learn the Enchanter's profession.  Ye'll find Gimble in his shop, Thistlefuzz Arcanery, right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.
Thanks to you, we can now unlock the secrets of the crystals and the mysterious pylons, $n. If you need more information at any time, please come back and visit me again!
Well well, not too bad. Maybe I CAN show you a few things...
I lost Lord Valthalak's Amulet!
$966w, young $c.

Bandages, anti-venoms and such things, these are the inevitable necessities of life on the plains.  Vira Younghoof can teach you this knowledge.  You can find her in the long house on the west side of Bloodhoof Village.
The officers' lounge
Don't bother me while I'm partying...
How you doin' mon!
I would like training.
A drink for friend Sarok and another for myself.
There are ways to strengthen steel beyond the hammer and forge, young wanderer. Care to learn more?

You freed Kirith from his suffering? Inconceivable -- and now Trebor has sent you here to learn of demons and their minions?$B$B<Loramus laughs.>$B$BBe thankful the arcane pangs have finally dissipated, $r.
%s begins translating ...

<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".>
Let the battle for Warsong Gulch begin!

Finally, Redridge. A pleasant change from the dark, cold fog of Duskwood.

Och!  Ye should be careful what ye get enchanted $glad : lass;.  I had me mug enchanted so it wouldn't spill a drop, but now I can't drink from it!  Such a tragedy.  

You be sure to heed me advice when ye see Gimble.  He'll be in his shop right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.
